messages:
anya.patel: FYI incoming high-priority from C-455. They report embeddings from our hosted API == 1536 dims but when routed to their Dedicated pool they get 1024. Customer says this started after a traffic bump yesterday.

matt.lewis: ugh. do we have any recent model swaps or rollout that could cause a variant with different embedding size to be served? which model id?

anya.patel: customer sent examples. Hosted call: `model: text-embed-3-large` -> embedding length 1536. Dedicated call (same prompt + same api key but through dedicated endpoint) -> embedding length 1024. They included curl snippets. i'm pasting sanitized logs.

support-bot: TRACE ID 8f3a2c4b - routed to dedicated-pool-7 - model-resolved: text-embed-3-large:v2-quant 

anya.patel: customer curl (hosted):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_hosted" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-3-large","input":"test sentence"}'
```
response snippet: `{"embedding": [...], "embedding_dimensions":1536}`

anya.patel: customer curl (dedicated):
```
curl -s -X POST https://dedicated-us.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_cust_dedicated" \
  -d '{"model":"text-embed-3-large","input":"test sentence"}'
```
response snippet: `{"embedding": [...], "embedding_dimensions":1024}`

olivia.k: interesting. the model name is the same but variant differs (support-bot trace shows v2-quant). v2-quant should still be 1536. 1024 suggests a different architecture (maybe text-embed-2 or a 1024-dim variant).

sandeep: two hypotheses: 1) routing fallback to an older model alias that was still tagged as text-embed-3-large in some Dedicated pools, 2) model metadata mismatch at the Dedicated runtime (metadata file wrong). both plausible. also check token scoping: apikeys can be pinned to a specific model alias mapping in Dedicated.

matt.lewis: can you repro internally? try hitting the Dedicated pool with one of our internal keys and check the resolved model_id and variant in the response headers. we add X-Redwood-Model and X-Redwood-Variant headers on debug builds.

deploy-bot: deploy event: dedicated-pool-7 config pushed by infra@2026-02-10T04:12Z - routing rules updated (auto-fallback policy enabled).

anya.patel: i repro'd with a debug token. Hosted shows headers: `X-Redwood-Model: text-embed-3-large`, `X-Redwood-Variant: base` and body dims 1536. Dedicated shows `X-Redwood-Model: text-embed-3-small` and `X-Redwood-Variant: quant-v1` with dims 1024. So routing actually resolved to `text-embed-3-small` in dedicated.

olivia.k: that aligns — fallback/auto-scaling may pick smaller variant to meet latency/throughput SLOs. But the customer expects consistent embeddings across environments. we need to treat embedding-dim as breaking change.

matt.lewis: immediate mitigation: tell customer to pin exact model variant by using model id `text-embed-3-large@v1` or add `model_variant=base` param. But need to confirm API supports that for Dedicated.

sandeep: long term: we should make embedding dimension part of model metadata exposed in catalog and enforce parity across variant families or surface a clear compatibility warning when variant changes dims. Also we need telemetry to detect cross-deploy dim swaps for same logical model name.

anya.patel: customer asked for repro steps and a timeline. i gave them a quick script to test both endpoints and to include `--include` to capture headers. they ran and attached 3 examples. they also noticed intermittent 429s when batching 200 items to Dedicated.

matt.lewis: batching note: Dedicated pool has batch-size ceilings; if the client tries to submit 200 items and batching policy coalesces, latency spikes and we may hit queue limits which lead to throttling. That would explain the 429s. but unrelated to dims mismatch.

olivia.k: action items: (1) pin customer to explicit variant to restore parity now, (2) investigate why routing rules allowed silent swap to smaller model in dedicated-pool-7, (3) review dedicated pool config for batch size/queue limit to address 429s.

support-bot: NOTE: customer wants rollback window — they prefer hosted behavior. last config change to dedicated-pool-7 was at 2026-02-10T04:12Z.

sandeep: I'll check the model alias mappings in the orchestration DB. likely cause: alias `text-embed-3-large` points to different variant sets per deployment group; a bad alias sync could have happened during rollout.

matt.lewis: also check commit in auto-fallback policy — there's a recent change to prefer lower-latency variants under high load. Maybe the policy didn't respect embedding-dim invariants. If so we need a safe-guard: do not auto-fallback to model variants with different embedding_dimensions for inference endpoints.

anya.patel: customer asks for a short-term config they can apply on their Dedicated side to prevent auto-fallback. is there a header or param?

olivia.k: yes, they can add `X-Redwood-Prefer-Variant: exact` (internal flag) or `model_variant=base` in the payload. i'll draft a support KB.

matt.lewis: for the 429s, ask them to reduce client-side batch size to 32 or use our async batching endpoint. also forward our suggested config: `max_batch_size=64, max_inflight=8` for their dedicated pool.

sandeep: found alias history: at 2026-02-09T22:50Z alias `text-embed-3-large` for dedicated-pool-7 was rewritten to include `text-embed-3-small` as a fallback. Looks like metadata mismatch between control plane and runtime images; one runtime hadn't picked up the updated catalog and still advertised the smaller variant as primary.

deploy-bot: runtime heartbeat: dedicated-pool-7 node-12 reported catalog-sync-fail at 2026-02-10T04:09Z, recovered at 2026-02-10T04:18Z.

anya.patel: i'll tell the customer we found root cause: alias/variant mismatch + auto-fallback policy. mitigation steps provided (pin variant + batch-size recommendation). also offering to run a one-time re-embedding for their corpus if they want to normalize dims (we'll quote offline).

olivia.k: please add follow-up: (A) make embedding_dimensions explicit in API responses and in model catalog UI, (B) add a config option on Dedicated to enforce exact-variant-only routing, (C) alerting for cross-deploy embedding-dim mismatches.

matt.lewis: agree. i'll open an eng ticket to add a safe-guard in the fallback policy and a quick patch to reject fallbacks across incompatible embedding dims.

anya.patel: customer acknowledged and will pin variant for now. they also asked for an ETA on the safeguard. i'll keep them updated. closing for now but keeping thread open for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

support-bot: Thread closed by anya.patel at 2026-02-10T05:12Z (customer notified).
